lines.en: label day333:
scene aminewuniform1
: So? What do you think?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？你觉得如何？

lines.en: : I had to put in a special request for a sailor style one, but the[school] seemed fine with it once I agreed to use my own money to pay.
lines.zh: : 水手服的款式我得特别申请才行，不过我答应自己掏钱之后，[school]那边似乎就没意见了。

lines.en: : This is what you’re spending your maid cafe money on?
lines.zh: : 你把在女仆咖啡厅赚的钱花在这上面了？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform2
: Of course it is!
lines.zh: : 当然啦！

lines.en: : You know darn well that I wouldn’t even have a job if you’d just buy me everything I wanted whenever I wanted it!
lines.zh: : 你明明清楚得很，要是你肯我要什么就给我买什么，我根本就用不着打工！

lines.en: : So excuse me for using my hard earned money to buy something that makes me look cute!
lines.zh: : 所以抱歉咯，我用自己辛苦赚来的钱，买让自己看起来可爱的东西！

lines.en: : Our old uniforms were super ugly anyway. I feel a lot more confident in clothes that actually fit my adorable and lovable personality.
lines.zh: : 反正我们以前的校服也丑爆了。穿上真正配得上我可爱又讨人喜欢的性格的衣服，我感觉自信多了。

lines.en: : You definitely look cuter in this.
lines.zh: : 你穿这身确实更可爱。

lines.en: : It does feel a little strange seeing you in something different, though.
lines.zh: : 不过看你穿着不一样的东西，感觉还是有点奇怪。

lines.en: : I’d gotten rather used to the old uniforms.
lines.zh: : 我已经相当习惯以前那套校服了。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform3
: I...actually didn’t even realize we were allowed to change them until you suddenly showed up in that one day.
lines.zh: : 我……其实根本不知道我们被允许换校服，直到你某天突然穿着那身出现。

lines.en: : And you didn’t find anything strange about all of the new girls having unique uniforms that didn’t at all match the ones we were given when we enrolled?
lines.zh: : 那那些新来的女生，每人身上的校服都独一无二，跟我们入学时发的那套完全不搭，你就没觉得哪里奇怪？

lines.en: : Yeah, [kumon_mi_high] seems pretty lax with the dress code and I’m glad that we’re finally addressing this.
lines.zh: : 是啊，[kumon_mi_high]在着装规范上似乎挺宽松的，我很高兴我们终于正视这件事了。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform4
: It was bound to happen eventually.
lines.zh: : 迟早会走到这一步的。

lines.en: : The[school] is okay with us wearing basically anything as long as there’s some sort of red or brown on it.
lines.zh: : 只要衣服上带点红色或棕色，[school]基本就允许我们穿什么都可以。

lines.en: : But Yasu’s uniform is entirely black and white.
lines.zh: : 可 Yasu 的校服是纯黑白的。

lines.en: : Hm. I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好像是的。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s so staff members can identify that she has special needs?
lines.zh: : 也许是方便教职员工辨认出她有特殊需求？

lines.en: : That’s a little rude, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这么说有点失礼吧，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly, no.
lines.zh: : 不觉得，没什么。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform5
: You’re happy with that, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你对此很满意？

lines.en: : I am. Totally.
lines.zh: : 满意。非常满意。

lines.en: : I’m also glad that I wasn’t the last one to actually get a new uniform since a few of the other girls are still waiting on theirs.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴自己不是最后一个换上新校服的人，因为还有几个女生在等着她们的呢。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’ll be quitting your job at the maid cafe, then?
lines.zh: : 那这是不是意味着，你要把女仆咖啡厅的工作辞了？

lines.en: : Hm? Why would I quit the maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我为什么要辞掉女仆咖啡厅？

lines.en: : I actually kinda like it there.
lines.zh: : 其实我还挺喜欢那里的。

lines.en: : I just wasn’t sure if there was anything else you needed to save up money for since Sensei provides food and shelter for you and you’ve already gotten a good amount of new clothes.
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定你还有什么别的地方需要攒钱，毕竟 Sensei 包了你吃住，而你也已经买了不少新衣服了。

lines.en: : True. But I have to save up for when my boobs finally start growing and none of my old clothes fit me anymore.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。但我得为胸部终于开始发育、以前的衣服全都穿不下那天存钱啊。

lines.en: : Ah.
: Yeah, you can probably just quit.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你大概直接辞职就行了。

lines.en: : You can probably just die.
lines.zh: : 你大概直接去死就行了。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform6
: If you two want my opinion-
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩想听听我的意见——

lines.en: : We don’t. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 不想。谢谢。

lines.en: : I do! Tell me I’m pretty!
lines.zh: : 我想！快说我漂亮！

lines.en: : I think you both look adorable.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们俩都很可爱。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform7
: Woo! Sensei loves me and wants to squeeze me to death!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Sensei 爱我，还想把我勒死！

lines.en: : Good. Now that you’ve successfully managed to make me throw up in my mouth, would you mind explaining to me why you’re still here?
lines.zh: : 很好。既然你成功让我把胃里的东西吐到了嘴里，能麻烦你解释一下，你为什么还在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Because...you said you had something you wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 因为……你说有话想跟我说。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound like something I’d say.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来不像是我会说的。

lines.en: She did.
lines.zh: 她确实说过。

lines.en: Granted, it was still very early in the day when she told me, so it’s possible she could have been sleep talking or something...
lines.zh: 虽说她告诉我的时候天还很早，所以也有可能是她在说梦话什么的……

lines.en: But there is absolutely no precedent for that, so I think it’s safe to assume she’s either just fucking with me or feigning ignorance.
lines.zh: 但这种事绝对没有先例，所以我想可以安全地假定，她要么只是在耍我，要么就是在装傻。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform8
: Is that why you can’t come to manga club today? Because you have to talk to Sensei about something?
lines.zh: : 这就是你今天不能去漫画社的原因吗？因为你要跟 Sensei 谈事情？

lines.en: : No. I’m not coming to manga club because Molly keeps trying to get me to dress up in skin tight, revealing cosplay and Sensei is still in the building.
lines.zh: : 不是。我不去漫画社，是因为 Molly 老是想让我穿上紧身暴露的 cosplay，而 Sensei 还在楼里。

lines.en: : So...you’d wear skin tight, revealing cosplay if I weren’t around?
lines.zh: : 所以……如果我不在，你就会穿紧身暴露的 cosplay？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform9
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : And I have no trouble saying that I’d likely knock it out of the park as well.
lines.zh: : 而且我可以毫不犹豫地说，我大概还能惊艳全场。

lines.en: : I am quite attractive.
lines.zh: : 我可是相当有魅力的。

lines.en: I silently wish to myself that I had been reincarnated with invisibility.
lines.zh: 我在心里默默希望，自己转世的时候能带上隐身的能力。

lines.en: : We could always just tell her to knock it off, you know...
lines.zh: : 我们随时都可以叫她别闹了，你知道的……

lines.en: : There’s no reason to skip out on a club meeting because of it.
lines.zh: : 没道理因为这个就不去参加社团活动。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform10
: I’ll come next time, I promise.
lines.zh: : 下次我会去的，我保证。

lines.en: : There actually is something I’d like to discuss with Sensei, though, if that isn’t a problem.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实有件事想和 Sensei 谈，如果没问题的的话。

lines.en: : Do you really need to ask for Ami’s permission?
lines.zh: : 你真的需要征求 Ami 的同意吗？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform11
: Ugh...fine. Permission granted.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。批准了。

lines.en: I guess that’s a yes.
lines.zh: 我想这就是“可以”的意思。

lines.en: : But only because I know you’d never do something like stab me in the back and try to steal him away from me because we’re best friends and we love each other.
lines.zh: : 但只是因为我知道，你绝不会干出在背后捅我刀子、把他从我身边抢走这种事——毕竟我们是最好的朋友，我们爱着彼此。

lines.en: : I can assure you that there are many of your “possessions” that I would sooner steal from you than Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，你的“所有物”里，有太多东西我都宁可先去偷，也轮不到 Sensei。

lines.en: : Hey. Come on.
lines.zh: : 喂。拜托。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform12
: Sensei, I have to leave for club now. But make sure you stay at least ten feet away from Maya at all times, okay?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我现在得去社团了。不过你要保证，时刻跟 Maya 保持至少十英尺的距离，好吗？

lines.en: : Are you assuming Maya would actually let me within ten feet of her to begin with?
lines.zh: : 你是假定 Maya 一开始就会让我靠近到十英尺以内？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Uhh.
: Anyway, be good!
lines.zh: : 总之，要乖哦！

lines.en: scene aminewuniform13
: I’ll be watching...
lines.zh: : 我会看着你的……

lines.en: scene aminewuniform14
: Ominous.
lines.zh: : 不祥啊。

lines.en: Ami exits the room and I can hear her shoes clopping against the floor as she skips her way to the manga club.
lines.zh: Ami 走出教室，我能听见她的鞋子在地板上哒哒作响，一路蹦跳着往漫画社去。

lines.en: In doing so, she creates the very rare situation of Maya and I being alone in the classroom- a thing that...I actually can’t remember ever happening before.
lines.zh: 这样一来，就制造出了极其罕见的局面——Maya 和我独自待在教室里。这种事……我其实不记得以前发生过。

lines.en: : Have we ever been alone in the classroom before?
lines.zh: : 我们以前有单独待在教室里过吗？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform15

lines.zh: : ……为什么问这个？

lines.en: : I’m just curious.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇。

lines.en: : Okay, but why are you curious? Why would that ever be a thing that you need to ponder over? I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 好吧，但你为什么好奇？为什么这会是你需要琢磨的事？我不明白。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, sorry. It was just a question.
lines.zh: : 天哪，抱歉。就是随口一问。

lines.en: : ...Whatever.
lines.zh: : ……随便吧。

lines.en: scene black
Maya breathes a heavy sigh and moves over to the window.
lines.zh: Maya 重重地叹了口气，走到窗边。

lines.en: I contemplate whether or not I’m supposed to follow her, but-
lines.zh: 我琢磨着自己是不是该跟过去，但——

lines.en: : It’s going to be hard to hear me if you stand all the way over there.
lines.zh: : 你站那么远，会很难听清我说话的。

lines.en: But she makes that decision for me and I proceed to join her.
lines.zh: 但她替我做了这个决定，于是我走过去，和她站到了一起。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform16
: Sorry. I was just following the rules and trying to stay ten feet away from you at all times.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是在遵守规则，努力时刻跟你保持十英尺的距离。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. As if you’d ever be able to follow a rule like that.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。好像你真能遵守那种规则似的。

lines.en: : Yes, Maya. You are irresistible and I can’t live without you.
lines.zh: : 是的，Maya。你让人无法抗拒，没有你我就活不下去。

lines.en: : It’s coming.
lines.zh: : 它要来了。

lines.en: : Wow, that was easy. All it took was a compliment to get you-
lines.zh: : 哇，这也太容易了。只要一句恭维就能让你——

lines.en: scene aminewuniform17
: The reset. Not whatever perverted scenario you instantaneously drummed up in your head.
lines.zh: : 是重置。不是你脑子里瞬间编排出来的什么变态剧情。

lines.en: : Well that’s significantly less fun.
lines.zh: : 那可就没意思多了。

lines.en: : Because it means there’s a chance for your personality to be wiped clean? Or because we’re not talking about sex?
lines.zh: : 是因为你的人格有被彻底清空的风险？还是因为我们没在聊性？

lines.en: : Both of them, but mostly the latter.
lines.zh: : 两个都有，但主要是后者。

lines.en: : Even in the face of death, you never cease to remind me of how disgusting you truly are.
lines.zh: : 即便面对死亡，你也从不停止提醒我，你到底有多恶心。

lines.en: : Well...it’s not really death if I’m just replaced by someone else, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果我只是被另一个人取代，那也算不上真正的死亡吧？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform18
: This might sound weird coming from me...but can you maybe try to value your existence a little more?
lines.zh: : 这话从我嘴里说出来可能有点怪……但你能不能试着更珍惜一点自己的存在？

lines.en: : This is the first time a single iteration of you will be watching the world end for a third consecutive time.
lines.zh: : 这是第一次，同一个“你”要连续第三次目睹世界的终结。

lines.en: : Wait, really? But I thought you said other Senseis have made it to winter before.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？可我记得你说过，别的 Sensei 有撑到冬天的。

lines.en: : Made it to, yes. But none have ever made it to the second half of it.
lines.zh: : 撑到冬天，是的。但没有一个撑到过冬天的下半段。

lines.en: : So it’s possible for my mind to be wiped before even getting to the reset?
lines.zh: : 所以我的记忆有可能在还没撑到重置之前就被清空？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform19
: Sure. Just as it’s also possible for you to die in a more traditional sense.
lines.zh: : 当然。就像你也完全有可能以更传统的方式死掉一样。

lines.en: : But I highly doubt you want to hear of all the times that has happened.
lines.zh: : 但我非常怀疑你想听那些发生过多少次。

lines.en: : Uhh...no, not really.
lines.zh: : 呃……不，真不想。

lines.en: : The point is...I think you should try and stay focused on doing everything in your power to stay who you are and where you are as the current record holder.
lines.zh: : 重点是……我觉得你应该尽量专注，尽你所能地保持住现在的自己、现在的位置，作为当前的纪录保持者。

lines.en: : Because you’ll miss me when I’m gone?
lines.zh: : 因为我走了你会想我？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform20
: Because the only thing a person like you would hate more than existing itself is not existing.
lines.zh: : 因为像你这种人，唯一比“存在本身”更讨厌的，就是“不存在”。

lines.en: : Deep.
lines.zh: : 深刻。

lines.en: : Shut up. You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : Just like how you also know you’re not ready to leave yet either.
lines.zh: : 就像你也清楚，你同样还没准备好离开。

lines.en: : You’re having far too much fun running around and convincing a bunch of naive girls that they’re in love with you.
lines.zh: : 你到处乱跑，说服一群天真的女孩以为自己爱上了你，这事儿你可乐在其中呢。

lines.en: : How do you know that this is fun for me? Even I'm not sure if I'd use that word to describe it.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道这对我来说是乐趣？连我自己都不确定会不会用这个词来形容。

lines.en: : Easy. I know you better than you know yourself.
lines.zh: : 简单。我比你更了解你自己。

lines.en: : I’ve known you much longer than you’ve known yourself, too, if my latest theory is correct. Which it probably is.
lines.zh: : 如果我最新的理论没错的话，我认识你的时间，也远比你认识自己的时间要长。而它大概没错。

lines.en: : Just be careful not to come out and say any more than that. Because if I go into shock and you start trying to have sex with me in the classroom, it might cause some problems for-
lines.zh: : 小心别再多说出什么了。因为要是我惊吓过度、你又开始在教室里想跟我做爱，那可能会给——

lines.en: scene aminewuniform21
: Yes, yes. I know.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我知道。

lines.en: : Forgive me for my momentary lapse in judgement as the world I knew came crumbling down around me.
lines.zh: : 原谅我那一刻的判断失误吧，毕竟我熟悉的世界正在我身边崩塌。

lines.en: : I can almost guarantee you that anyone in my shoes would have done the exact same thing.
lines.zh: : 我几乎可以保证，任何处在我这个位置上的人，都会做出一模一样的事。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I think you might just be a secret pervert.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。我觉得你大概就是个隐藏的变态。

lines.en: : I’m not a secret pervert.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么隐藏的变态。

lines.en: : How can I be so sure?
lines.zh: : 我怎么能这么肯定？

lines.en: : Because...I’m not. Now, can we please talk about the reset?
lines.zh: : 因为……我不是。好了，我们能谈谈重置的事了吗？

lines.en: : That is the reason I called you here, after all.
lines.zh: : 那毕竟是我叫你来的原因。

lines.en: : Fine, fine.
lines.zh: : 行，行。

lines.en: : So, it’s coming and I’ve never made it that far before.
lines.zh: : 那么，它要来了，而我以前从没撑到过那么远。

lines.en: : Do you have some sort of plan or something that will help me...survive?
lines.zh: : 你有什么计划，或者什么能帮我……活下来的办法吗？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform16
: I have one plan, but I don’t think you’ll like it.
lines.zh: : 我有一个计划，但我觉得你不会喜欢。

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: : Killing Noriko.
lines.zh: : 杀掉 Noriko。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t like that at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我一点也不喜欢。

lines.en: : I also don’t think that would change anything and that you’re just letting your grudge get the better of you again.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不觉得那能改变什么，你只是又让旧怨占了上风。

lines.en: : Possibly. But I do think it would be better to be safe than sorry.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但我确实认为小心为上。

lines.en: : Any plans that don’t involve killing one of your classmates?
lines.zh: : 有没有不涉及杀同班同学的计划？

lines.en: scene aminewuniform20
: Just to do things normally again, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想，就是重新按常规来做吧。

lines.en: : Last time, I was an absolute idiot and let my mind get crowded during the process. Which may or may not have led to the destruction of an entire[school].
lines.zh: : 上一次，我蠢透了，在这个过程里让自己的脑子被挤得满满当当。这可能就是——也可能不是——导致整整一所[school]被毁掉的原因。

lines.en: : It’s still hard to tell if that was my fault or not.
lines.zh: : 那到底是不是我的错，现在还很难说。

lines.en: : But given that it was such an unusual change, I can’t help but hold myself at least slightly responsible.
lines.zh: : 但鉴于那是如此异常的变化，我忍不住要至少稍微归咎于自己。

lines.en: : If everyone you’ve met over the last couple months does disappear, though, know that I will not shed a single tear and that I would actually prefer things that way.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你这几个月认识的所有人真的消失了，你要知道，我一滴眼泪都不会掉，而且我其实更希望事情变成那样。

lines.en: : Really? Even after the dorm wars?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？连宿舍大战之后也这样？

lines.en: : You won’t feel upset about all of your new friends just vanishing overnight?
lines.zh: : 你所有那些新朋友一夜之间就这么消失了，你不会难受？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太会。

lines.en: : I’ve become rather exceptional at not getting attached to anything since my life has been reduced to near-quarterly looping through the same[school] year over and over and over.
lines.zh: : 自从我的人生被压缩成近乎以季度为单位、在同一个[school]学年里一遍又一遍又一遍地循环之后，我已经相当擅长不去依恋任何东西了。

lines.en: : It’s incredibly exhausting, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这累得要命。

lines.en: : Well, hopefully I’m able to continue exhausting you in the future.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望我以后还能继续让你累下去。

lines.en: : It would kind of suck if things just ended here.
lines.zh: : 要是事情就这么结束了，那可挺没劲的。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform22
: Good. That’s exactly what I wanted to hear.
lines.zh: : 很好。这正是我想听到的。

lines.en: : Start treasuring your life.
lines.zh: : 开始珍惜你的生命。

lines.en: : Treasure it...but don’t do anything stupid with it either.
lines.zh: : 珍惜它……但也别拿它去干蠢事。

lines.en: : It can be scary how fragile our existence is at times.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我们的存在有多脆弱，想想都让人害怕。

lines.en: : One wrong move and you might wind up back at the start.
lines.zh: : 一步走错，你可能就回到了起点。

lines.en: : I hope things don’t come to that, though, because...
lines.zh: : 不过我希望事情别走到那一步，因为……

lines.en: scene aminewuniform23
: Well...
: It would probably be a little more exhausting having to explain everything over again from the beginning.
lines.zh: : 要从头再把一切解释一遍，大概会让人累上加累。

lines.en: : You know basically just as much as I do now.
lines.zh: : 你现在知道的东西，基本上已经和我一样多了。

lines.en: : Well, about the world and how it works, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少关于这个世界和它的运作方式，是这样。

lines.en: : There’s still plenty I know about your history that I can’t disclose without the fear of melting your brain.
lines.zh: : 关于你的过去，我还有很多不能说——怕把你的脑子烧坏。

lines.en: : But life itself feels new again.
lines.zh: : 但生命本身让人感觉焕然一新。

lines.en: : Everything that’s happened recently is something I’ve never seen.
lines.zh: : 最近发生的这一切，都是我从未见过的。

lines.en: : And...it’s terrifying.
lines.zh: : 而且……这很可怕。

lines.en: scene aminewuniform20
: But that’s enough of my expressive self for today.
lines.zh: : 不过，我今天这份“多愁善感”就到此为止吧。

lines.en: : Really? You looked cute with your little smile just now.
lines.zh: : 是吗？你刚才微微一笑的样子还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : I’ve warned you of the encroaching reset, so now it’s entirely on you to make it to the roof.
lines.zh: : 我已经警告过你，重置正在逼近，所以现在全靠你自己撑到天台了。

lines.en: : Can you just meet me at my house next time?
lines.zh: : 下次你能不能直接来我家找我？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. That is a horrible idea and never plays out the way I expect it to.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。那是个糟糕透顶的主意，而且从来都不会按我预期的方式发展。

lines.en: : Just save both of us some trouble and come to the roof on your own.
lines.zh: : 省得我们俩都麻烦，你自己上天台来吧。

lines.en: : I’ll be waiting...
lines.zh: : 我会等着的……

lines.en: : Just like always.
lines.zh: : 就像一直以来那样。

lines.en: scene black
Maya goes to leave the classroom and I follow closely behind her.
lines.zh: Maya 走出教室，我紧随其后。

lines.en: Not because I’m trying to spend more time with her or anything, but because it would simply be strange for me to continue standing around here when the final bell rang nearly an hour ago.
lines.zh: 不是因为我想多跟她待一会儿什么的，而是因为终响铃都快一个小时前就敲过了，我还继续杵在这儿实在太奇怪。

lines.en: : Stop following me.
lines.zh: : 别跟着我。

lines.en: : We’re both leaving[school], aren’t we? What’s the harm in walking together for a little while?
lines.zh: : 我们俩不都要离开[school]吗？一起走一小段路又有什么坏处？

lines.en: : There is no harm. It’s just not something I particularly enjoy.
lines.zh: : 没有坏处。只是我不怎么享受而已。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just walk silently behind you and admire you from the back then.
lines.zh: : 那没事。我就静静地走在你后面，从背后欣赏你好了。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。
